full_name: Revised visual disability questionnaire for Japanese glaucoma patients (Japanese, vertical reading)
domains: 7 items: letters; sentences; walking; going out; dining; dressing; miscellaneous
response_scale: 3 responses scored greatly disabled 2, slightly disabled 1, not disabled 0
scoring: item DI = mean score of questions within each item; total DI = sum of the item DIs
validation_method: factor analysis; internal consistency; test-retest; criterion validity
target_population: Japanese glaucoma patients (reading and writing vertically)
notes: Revised from 35-question preliminary questionnaire by principal components (5 questions dropped) (p7). Item-to-total r 0.81-0.91, Cronbach alpha 0.85-0.88, test-retest kappa 0.9-1.0 on 30 questions (Appendix p8); questions in Table 1 p3; no name given in paper
